","zig_213.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_214.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_215.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_216.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_217.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_218.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_219.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_220.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_221.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_222.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_223.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_224.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_225.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_226.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_227.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_228.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_229.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_230.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_231.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_232.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_233.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_234.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_235.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_236.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_237.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_238.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_239.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_240.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","zig_241.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"};</script>
<script>
'use strict';
const BANK=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('#game-data').textContent),TOPICS=['animals','food','sports','entertainment','people','colors','places','activities'];
const LABELS={animals:['Animals','动物','🐾'],food:['Food','食物','🍜'],sports:['Sports','运动','⚽'],entertainment:['Entertainment','娱乐','🎭'],people:['People','人物','👩‍🚀'],colors:['Colors','颜色','🎨'],places:['Places','地点','🏞️'],activities:['Activities','活动','🎲']};
const WORLDS=[
 {name:'Sound Moon',cn:'语音月球',icon:'💠',sub:'Phonics · Hear sounds and syllables',img:0,goal:'Power up the alien sound crystals.',skills:'Sound Detective / Syllable Pulse',modes:['sound','syllable']},
 {name:'Discovery Planet',cn:'探索星球',icon:'🛸',sub:'Vocabulary · Recognize and categorize words',img:1,goal:'Scan everything Zig has collected from Earth.',skills:'Holo Scanner / Cargo Sort',modes:['scanner','sort']},
 {name:'Phrase Forge',cn:'短语工厂',icon:'⚙️',sub:'Phrases · Join two or three words',img:3,goal:'Repair the glowing word-combination machine.',skills:'Phrase Reactor / Habitat Match',modes:['phrase','habitat']},
 {name:'Starship Express',cn:'句子列车',icon:'🚄',sub:'Sentences · Make complete ideas',img:4,goal:'Build sentence trains to restart the engines.',skills:'Sentence Train / Signal Repair',modes:['train','gap']},
 {name:'Reason Nebula',cn:'原因星云',icon:'🌌',sub:'Complex sentences · because, and, but',img:5,goal:'Use reasons and comparisons to restore the star map.',skills:'Reason Bridge / Logic Laser',modes:['because','contrast']}
];
const DESCRIPTIONS={sound:['Sound Detective','听单词，选择开头的字母或字母组合。','Listen to the word. Pick the first sound.'],syllable:['Syllable Pulse','听一听，数一数单词有几个音节。','Listen and count the beats.'],scanner:['Holo Scanner','听或看单词，点选对应的图片。','Find the matching picture.'],sort:['Cargo Sort','判断单词属于哪个类别。','Sort the object into the right category.'],phrase:['Phrase Reactor','按正确顺序点击词块，组成短语。','Tap the chunks to build a phrase.'],habitat:['Habitat Match','根据地点，选择在这里能做的事情。','Match the place and the action.'],train:['Sentence Train','按正确顺序点击车厢，造出完整的句子。','Build a whole sentence.'],gap:['Signal Repair','看图片和句子，选词填空。','Choose the missing word.'],because:['Reason Bridge','选择合适的原因，完成 because 句子。','Choose a reason that makes sense.'],contrast:['Logic Laser','and 表示“并且”，but 表示“但是”。选对连接词。','Choose and or but.']};
const SOUND=[["skating","sk","st","sw"],["swimming","sw","sk","st"],["playground","pl","pr","bl"],["purple","p","b","t"],["turtle","t","d","p"],["dolphin","d","b","g"],["noodles","n","m","p"],["dumplings","d","p","t"]];
const SYLLABLE=[["duck",1],["skating",2],["swimming",2],["dolphin",2],["playground",2],["skateboarding",3],["gymnastics",3],["badminton",3]];
const SCAN=[["animals","dolphin"],["food","noodles"],["sports","badminton"],["entertainment","comic book"],["people","singer"],["colors","purple"],["places","aquarium"],["activities","taking photos"]];
const SORT=[['turtle','animals'],['dumplings','food'],['skating','sports'],['comic book','entertainment'],['firefighter','people'],['purple','colors'],['library','places'],['doing puzzles','activities']];
const PHRASES=[['sleepy','bear'],['slow','turtle'],['playful','monkey'],['favorite','animal'],['taking','photos'],['doing','puzzles'],['building','with','blocks'],['flying','a','kite']];
const HABITATS=[['aquarium','watch sharks'],['library','read books'],['farm','see animals'],['beach','play in the sand'],['museum','see old things'],['bakery','buy bread'],['park','play games'],['zoo','see animals']];
const TRAINS=[["My favorite","animal","is","a dolphin."],["My favorite","food","is","dumplings."],["My favorite","sport","is","badminton."],["My favorite","color","is","purple."],["My favorite","place","is","the library."],["My favorite","activity","is","drawing."],["I like","noodles."],["I like","comic books."]];
const GAP=[["animals","dolphin","My favorite animal is a ____.","dolphin",["dolphin","turtle","zebra"]],["food","dumplings","My favorite food is ____.","dumplings",["dumplings","noodles","soup"]],["sports","badminton","My favorite sport is ____.","badminton",["badminton","volleyball","skating"]],["colors","purple","My favorite color is ____.","purple",["purple","pink","orange"]],["places","library","I like the ____.","library",["library","beach","aquarium"]],["activities","drawing","I like ____.","drawing",["drawing","reading","painting"]],["entertainment","cartoon","I like ____.","cartoons",["cartoons","songs","games"]],["food","noodles","I like ____.","noodles",["noodles","dumplings","rice"]]];
const BECAUSE=[
 ['I like the library because I can ____.','read books',['read books','swim with sharks','ride a horse'],'library'],
 ['I like the aquarium because I can ____.','watch sharks',['watch sharks','play soccer','buy bread'],'aquarium'],
 ['I like the farm because I can ____.','see animals',['see animals','watch a movie','read in class'],'farm'],
 ['I like the beach because I can ____.','play in the sand',['play in the sand','read at school','buy a cake'],'beach'],
 ['I like soccer because it is ____.','exciting',['exciting','purple','penguins'],'soccer'],
 ['I like cartoons because they are ____.','funny',['funny','yellow','at the beach'],'cartoon'],
 ['I like dumplings because they are ____.','delicious',['delicious','a library','running'],'dumplings'],
 ['I like drawing because it is ____.','creative',['creative','a giraffe','read books'],'drawing']
];
const CONTRAST=[
 ['I like noodles, ___ I like dumplings.','and','and',['and','but']],['I like noodles, ___ I don’t like soup.','but','but',['and','but']],
 ['I like reading, ___ I like drawing.','and','and',['and','but']],['I like skating, ___ I don’t like boxing.','but','but',['and','but']],
 ['I like pandas, ___ I like penguins.','and','and',['and','but']],['I like apples, ___ I don’t like carrots.','but','but',['and','but']],
 ['I like puzzles, ___ I like games.','and','and',['and','but']],['I like the beach, ___ I don’t like the museum.','but','but',['and','but']]
];
const MODE_COUNT=8;
const by=(id)=>document.getElementById(id), bankEntry=(topic,en)=>BANK[topic]?.find(w=>w.en.toLowerCase()===en.toLowerCase()), findEntry=(en)=>TOPICS.flatMap(t=>BANK[t]).find(w=>w.en.toLowerCase()===en.toLowerCase());
const saveKey='zig-star-map-lesson2-v1';const defaultState=()=>({modes:{},accuracy:{total:0,correct:0,hints:0},encountered:{},said:0});let state;try{state={...defaultState(),...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(saveKey)||'{}')}}catch{state=defaultState()}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(saveKey,JSON.stringify(state))}catch{}}
let page='home',world=0,mode='',turn=0,wrong=0,chosen=[],isSolved=false,correctThis=0,lastSpeech='',showChinese=false,bankTopic='animals',teacherPreview=false;
function img(src){return CARD_IMAGES[src]||''}function card(topic,word){const v=bankEntry(topic,word)||findEntry(word);return v?`<img src="${img(v.id)}" alt="${esc(v.en)}">`:''}function esc(x){return String(x??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function spoken(text){lastSpeech=text;const filename=VOICE_MAP[text],src=filename?VOICE_BASE64[filename]:null;const a=by('zigReplay');if(a){a.title=src?'Play Jesse recording':'Recording unavailable for this line';a.classList.toggle('missing',!src)}if(src){if(window.__zigNarrator){window.__zigNarrator.pause();window.__zigNarrator.currentTime=0}let player=new Audio(src);window.__zigNarrator=player;player.volume=.95;player.play().catch(()=>{});return true}return false}
function blip(good){try{let c=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=good?650:260;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.08,c.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,c.currentTime+.18);o.connect(g).connect(c.destination);o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+.19)}catch{}}
function zsay(text,audioText){by('zigMessage').textContent=text;const onstage=by('sceneCommsText');if(onstage)onstage.textContent=text;spoken(audioText||text)}
function updateHud(){let n=crystals();by('crystalCount').textContent=n;by('progBar').style.width=(n*20)+'%';by('zigPortrait').src=ZIG_PORTRAIT}
function crystals(){return WORLDS.reduce((n,w)=>n+(w.modes.every(m=>state.modes[m])) ,0)}
function eligible(n){return n===0||WORLDS[n-1].modes.every(m=>state.modes[m])||teacherPreview}
function theme(i,tag,title,desc){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--world-scene',`url("${SCENES[i]}")`);document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--map-scene',`url("${SCENES[5]}")`);by('hero').style.setProperty('--scene',`url("${SCENES[i]}")`);by('heroTag').textContent=tag;by('heroTitle').innerHTML=title;by('heroText').textContent=desc;updateHud()}
function home(){page='home';mode='';theme(2,'ZIG NEEDS YOUR HELP','Five crystals. <em>One star map.</em>','The alien starship needs sounds, words, phrases and sentences to travel home.');zsay('Ready, Allen? Let’s explore!','Ready, Allen? Let’s explore!');by('main').innerHTML=`<div class="sectiontitle"><h2>🌌 Galaxy Map</h2><small>按顺序学习，每颗星球有多个不同的小游戏。</small></div><div class="zone-grid">${WORLDS.map((w,i)=>`<button class="zone-card ${eligible(i)?'':'locked'} ${w.modes.every(m=>state.modes[m])?'done':''}" style="--scene:url('${SCENES[w.img]}')" data-world="${i}"><span class="zone-n">${w.icon} ${i+1} / 5 ${!eligible(i)?'🔒':''}</span><h3>${w.name}</h3><p>${w.cn} · ${w.sub}</p><span class="status">${w.modes.every(m=>state.modes[m])?'💎 CRYSTAL COLLECTED':!eligible(i)?'Complete previous planet':'✨ Explore / 开始探索'}</span></button>`).join('')}<button class="zone-card finale ${crystals()<5?'locked':'done'}" style="--scene:url('${SCENES[5]}')" data-finale="1"><span class="zone-n">🌠 FINAL ADVENTURE</span><h3>Zig’s Star Map Finale</h3><p>All your favorite things, together! · 最后复习</p><span class="status">${crystals()<5?'🔒 Collect 5 crystals':'🚀 Star map repaired!'}</span></button></div><div class="glass map-foot">🌟 Use the <b>Word Atlas</b> any time. Extra words are optional. <span lang="zh">单词图鉴可自由复习，额外单词不是必做。</span></div>`;by('main').querySelectorAll('[data-world]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>openWorld(+el.dataset.world)));by('main').querySelector('[data-finale]').addEventListener('click',()=>crystals()===5||teacherPreview?finale():flash('先收集五颗水晶，再来修复星图。'))}
function openWorld(i){if(!eligible(i)){flash('先完成前一颗星球。 Finish the planet before this one.');blip(false);return}page='world';world=i;const w=WORLDS[i];theme(w.img,`WORLD ${i+1} OF 5 • ${w.cn}`,`${w.icon} ${esc(w.name)}`,w.goal);zsay('Choose a mission to help Zig.','Choose your answer.');by('main').innerHTML=`<div class="glass scene-panel"><h2>🛰️ ${w.name} <small class="muted">${w.cn}</small></h2><p>${w.sub}</p><p><b>Mission:</b> ${w.goal}</p><div class="mission-row">${w.modes.map((m,k)=>`<button class="mission ${state.modes[m]?'complete':''}" data-mode="${m}"><b>${['🚀','💡'][k]} ${DESCRIPTIONS[m][0]}</b><small lang="zh">${DESCRIPTIONS[m][1]}</small><em>${state.modes[m]?'✓ Completed / 已完成':'▶ PLAY • 8 rounds'}</em></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="actions"><button class="action ghost" id="returnMap">◀ Galaxy Map</button></div></div>`;by('returnMap').onclick=home;by('main').querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>startMode(el.dataset.mode));}
function startMode(m){page='game';mode=m;turn=0;wrong=0;chosen=[];correctThis=0;isSolved=false;theme(WORLDS[world].img,`MISSION · ${DESCRIPTIONS[m][0].toUpperCase()}`,`<em>${DESCRIPTIONS[m][0]}</em>`,DESCRIPTIONS[m][2]);renderRound();}
function targetArr(){return mode==='sound'?SOUND:mode==='syllable'?SYLLABLE:mode==='scanner'?SCAN:mode==='sort'?SORT:mode==='phrase'?PHRASES:mode==='habitat'?HABITATS:mode==='train'?TRAINS:mode==='gap'?GAP:mode==='because'?BECAUSE:CONTRAST}
function roundData(){const q=targetArr();return q[turn%q.length]}
function mixed(items,key){let a=[...items];let n=turn+7;for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=(n*13+i*7)%(i+1);[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];n++}if(a.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:JSON.stringify(x)).join('|')===items.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:JSON.stringify(x)).join('|') && a.length>1)[a[0],a[1]]=[a[1],a[0]];return a}
function observe(word){const v=findEntry(word);if(v){state.encountered[v.id]=(state.encountered[v.id]||0)+1;save()}}
function answerBtn(text,key,opts={}){const label=opts.pic?`<img alt="${esc(text)}" src="${opts.pic}"><span>${esc(text)}</span>`:esc(text);return `<button class="answer ${opts.pic?'picture':''} ${opts.small?'small':''}" data-choice="${esc(key??text)}">${label}</button>`}
function renderRound(){isSolved=false;chosen=[];wrong=0;let r=roundData(),head='',opts='',zh='',visual='',expected='',audio='';
 const e=findEntry(mode==='scanner'?r[1]:['sound','syllable','sort','habitat'].includes(mode)?r[0]:'');
 if(mode==='sound') {const [w,right,x,y]=r;const v=findEntry(w);head='What sound comes first?';zh='听单词，选择开头的字母或字母组合。';visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span style="font-size:34px">🎧</span><strong>${esc(w)}</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(w)}">🔊 Listen</button></div><div class="assist">${card(v?.id.split('_')[0]||'animals',w)}</div>`;opts=mixed([right,x,y]).map(s=>answerBtn(s,s)).join('');expected=right;audio=w;observe(w)}
 if(mode==='syllable'){const [w,n]=r;head='How many syllables?';zh='听一听，拍手数音节。一个音节拍一下。';visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span style="font-size:34px">👏</span><strong>${esc(w)}</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(w)}">🔊 Listen</button></div><p class="muted">1, 2, or 3 beats? 数一数拍手次数</p>`;opts=[1,2,3].map(n=>answerBtn(String(n)+' 👏'.repeat(n),n)).join('');expected=String(n);audio=w;observe(w)}
 if(mode==='scanner'){const [topic,w]=r;head='Find it with the scanner!';zh='点击和单词对应的图片。可以点扬声器听发音。';const pool=BANK[topic],target=bankEntry(topic,w)||pool[0];const distract=mixed(pool.filter(x=>x.en!==w)).slice(0,3);visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span style="font-size:34px">🔎</span><strong>${esc(w)}</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(w)}">🔊 Listen</button></div>`;opts=mixed([target,...distract]).map(v=>answerBtn('',v.id,{pic:img(v.id)})).join('');expected=target.id;audio=w;observe(w)}
 if(mode==='sort'){const [w,t]=r;head='Send the cargo home!';zh='判断这个单词属于哪一类。';let v=findEntry(w);visual=`<div class="listenrow">${card(t,w)}<strong>${esc(w)}</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(w)}">🔊 Listen</button></div>`;opts=mixed([t,...TOPICS.filter(x=>x!==t).slice(0,3)]).map(t=>answerBtn(`${LABELS[t][2]} ${LABELS[t][0]} · ${LABELS[t][1]}`,t,{small:true})).join('');expected=t;audio=w;observe(w)}
 if(mode==='phrase'){head='Build the phrase!';zh='按顺序点击词块，把词连成短语。点击上方词块可以撤销。';expected=r.join(' ');visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span>🧲</span><strong>${esc(expected)}</strong></div><div class="builder" id="builder"><span class="muted">Tap tiles below →</span></div><div class="word-bank" id="bankTiles">${mixed(r.map((x,i)=>({x,i}))).map(({x,i})=>`<button class="word-chip" data-tile="${i}">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;opts='<button class="action" data-check="1">⚡ Power up phrase</button><button class="action ghost" data-clear="1">↺ Clear</button>';}
 if(mode==='habitat'){const [place,action]=r;head='What can Zig do here?';zh='根据地点，选择在这里能做的事。';visual=`<div class="listenrow">${card('places',place)}<strong>At the ${esc(place)}...</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(place)}">🔊 Listen</button></div>`;let pool=mixed(HABITATS.filter(([p,a])=>p!==place&&a!==action).map(x=>x[1]));opts=mixed([action,...pool.slice(0,2)]).map(a=>answerBtn(a,a,{small:true})).join('');expected=action;audio=place;observe(place)}
 if(mode==='train'){head='Build the sentence train!';zh='按顺序点车厢，组出完整的句子。';expected=r.join(' ');visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span>🚄</span><strong>Sentence Train</strong><button class="audio-btn" data-speak="${esc(expected)}">🔊 Model</button></div><div class="builder" id="builder"><span class="muted">Tap carriages →</span></div><div class="word-bank" id="bankTiles">${mixed(r.map((x,i)=>({x,i}))).map(({x,i})=>`<button class="word-chip" data-tile="${i}">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;opts='<button class="action" data-check="1">🚂 Start the train</button><button class="action ghost" data-clear="1">↺ Clear</button>';audio=expected;}
 if(mode==='gap'){const [t,w,s,right,options]=r;head='Repair the missing signal!';zh='看图选词，让句子完整。';visual=`<div class="listenrow">${card(t,w)}<strong>${esc(s)}</strong></div>`;opts=mixed(options).map(x=>answerBtn(x,x,{small:true})).join('');expected=right;observe(w)}
 if(mode==='because'){const [s,right,options,subject]=r;head='Why? Build the reason bridge!';zh='because 表示“因为”。选择最合适的原因。';const v=findEntry(subject);visual=`<div class="listenrow">${v?`<img alt="${esc(subject)}" style="width:96px;height:76px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;background:#fff" src="${img(v.id)}">`:'🌉'}<strong>${esc(s)}</strong></div>`;opts=mixed(options).map(x=>answerBtn(x,x,{small:true})).join('');expected=right;observe(subject)}
 if(mode==='contrast'){const [s,right,_,options]=r;head='And or But?';zh='and 表示“并且”；but 表示“但是”。看句子意思，选择连接词。';visual=`<div class="listenrow"><span>⚡</span><strong>${esc(s)}</strong></div>`;opts=options.map(x=>answerBtn(x,x)).join('');expected=right;}
 const dots=Array.from({length:MODE_COUNT},(_,i)=>`<i class="${i<turn?'yes':i===turn?'now':''}"></i>`).join('');const answerZoneClass=['phrase','train'].includes(mode)?'actions':mode==='scanner'?'answer-grid picture-grid':'answer-grid';by('main').innerHTML=`<section class="glass game immersive-scene"><div class="game-top"><span class="chip">${esc(DESCRIPTIONS[mode][0])}</span><div class="stepdots">${dots}</div><span class="chip">${turn+1}/${MODE_COUNT}</span></div><h2>${head}</h2><p class="explain" lang="zh">${zh}</p><div class="scene-comms" role="group" aria-label="Zig's voice guidance"><img src="${ZIG_PORTRAIT}" alt="Zig"><div class="comms-copy"><div class="comms-label">ZIG · MISSION RADIO</div><p id="sceneCommsText">Listen and explore!</p></div><button id="sceneReplay" type="button" aria-label="Replay Zig's voice" title="Listen again">🔊</button></div>${visual}<div class="${answerZoneClass}" id="answerZone">${opts}</div><div class="hints"><button class="hint" id="helpBtn">💡 Help / 中文提示</button><button class="hint" id="repeatBtn">🔊 Hear again</button><button class="hint" id="rGuide">🔊 Instructions / 玩法</button><button class="hint" id="backBtn">◀ Back to planet</button></div><div id="feedback" class="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">Choose your answer. 选择答案。</div><div id="hintText" class="assist hidden"></div></section>`;
 by('main').querySelectorAll('[data-speak]').forEach(btn=>{btn.onclick=(ev)=>{ev.preventDefault();ev.stopPropagation();if(!spoken(btn.dataset.speak)){flash('This Jesse recording is not installed yet. 这段录音尚未安装。')}}});
 by('helpBtn').onclick=()=>{state.accuracy.hints++;save();const hint=by('hintText');hint.classList.remove('hidden');hint.textContent=hintForMode(r,expected);blip(true)};
 by('repeatBtn').onclick=()=>{if(audio)spoken(audio);else spoken(ZIG_VOICE_GUIDES[mode]||'Choose your answer.');const feedback=by('feedback');if(audio&&(!VOICE_MAP[audio]||!VOICE_BASE64[VOICE_MAP[audio]]))feedback.textContent='这句话还没有录音，可以看文字继续。 This line has no audio yet.'};
 by('rGuide').onclick=()=>spoken(ZIG_VOICE_GUIDES[mode]||DESCRIPTIONS[mode][2]);
 by('backBtn').onclick=()=>openWorld(world);
 by('answerZone').querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>judge(el.dataset.choice,expected,el));
 if(['phrase','train'].includes(mode)){
  by('bankTiles').querySelectorAll('[data-tile]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(isSolved)return;b.disabled=true;chosen.push(+b.dataset.tile);syncBuilder(r)});
  by('answerZone').querySelector('[data-check]').onclick=()=>judge(chosen.map(i=>r[i]).join(' '),expected,null);
  by('answerZone').querySelector('[data-clear]').onclick=()=>{chosen=[];syncBuilder(r)};
 }
 zsay(DESCRIPTIONS[mode][2],ZIG_VOICE_GUIDES[mode]||audio||'Choose your answer.');}
function hintForMode(r,expected){if(mode==='sound')return `开头发音字母：${r[1]}。先听完整单词，再读开头音。`;if(mode==='syllable')return '一个音节拍一下手。Try clapping with the word.';if(mode==='scanner'||mode==='sort'||mode==='gap'){const word=mode==='scanner'?r[1]:mode==='sort'?r[0]:r[1],item=findEntry(word);return item?`${item.en} = ${item.zh}。看图片，再选正确答案。`:'看图片再选。'}if(mode==='phrase'||mode==='train')return '按句子的自然顺序排：说话的人 → 动作/喜欢 → 事物。先尝试，再核对。';if(mode==='habitat')return '想一想：这里能做什么？例如：library → read books（图书馆→看书）。';if(mode==='because')return 'because = 因为。找一个有意义的原因，而不是随便选一个词。';return 'and = 并且，but = 但是。两个意思相反，用 but。';}
function syncBuilder(r){let html=chosen.length?chosen.map((i,k)=>`<button class="word-chip" data-remove="${k}">${esc(r[i])} ×</button>`).join(''):'<span class="muted">Tap tiles below →</span>';by('builder').innerHTML=html;by('builder').querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{chosen.splice(+b.dataset.remove,1);syncBuilder(r)});by('bankTiles').querySelectorAll('[data-tile]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=chosen.includes(+b.dataset.tile))}
function judge(response,expected,button){if(isSolved)return;let good=String(response)===String(expected);state.accuracy.total++;if(good){state.accuracy.correct++;correctThis++;isSolved=true;blip(true);if(turn===7)spoken('Great work! You found a crystal!');if(button){button.classList.add('correct')}by('feedback').className='feedback good';by('feedback').innerHTML=`🌟 Great! ${esc(expected)} <span lang="zh">· 答对了！</span><div style="margin-top:11px"><button class="action" id="nextBtn">Next → 下一题</button></div>`;by('nextBtn').onclick=nextRound;if(mode==='train'||mode==='phrase')spoken(expected);if(mode==='because')spoken(roundData()[0].replace('____',expected));if(mode==='contrast')spoken(roundData()[0].replace('___',expected))}else{wrong++;blip(false);spoken('Try another one.');if(button){button.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(()=>button.classList.remove('bad'),360)}by('feedback').className='feedback try';by('feedback').textContent=wrong>1?'再试一次！Try again. Tap 💡 Help for a Chinese explanation.':'Not yet! Try again. 再想一想。'}save()}
function nextRound(){turn++;if(turn>=MODE_COUNT){state.modes[mode]=true;save();finishMode();return}renderRound()}

function atlas(topic){page='atlas';bankTopic=topic||bankTopic;theme(1,'BONUS DISCOVERY','The <em>Word Atlas</em>','144 full-color illustrated vocabulary words from Allen’s real Lesson 2 resources.
